description: Activate when: user says 'how do we watch the agent after launch', 'AI output quality is getting worse', 'inference spend suddenly jumped', 'the agent broke something, how do we roll back', 'we need an AI ops weekly review', or an AI agent is already in production handling real business. Do NOT activate when: the project is still at the business-case stage (use ai-roi-business-case); usage is one-off and manual with no ongoing traffic. More: deciqai.com/c/agent-ops-monitoring

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
